name: VEX
title: The Stiletto
lore: Born in the back rooms of an underground techno club. Vex learned to fight in strobe lights — every movement is rhythmic, precise, lethal. Rumored to have never been hit clean in a ranked match. Wears her kills as tally marks etched into her collar.
personality: Cold, surgical, vain. Moves like she knows she's being watched. Never wastes a motion. Talks in clipped, dismissive one-liners.

visualDesign.silhouette: Sleek and elongated. Long limbs, narrow waist, exaggerated leg-to-body ratio. Built for speed — anime-proportioned agility type.
visualDesign.furBase: Jet black with a subtle blue-purple sheen in the light, like raven feathers
visualDesign.furAccents: Siamese-style point markings but in deep indigo instead of brown. Gradient fade from black body into indigo at extremities (paws, ears, muzzle, tail tip).

eyes.shape: Sharp, angular, almost feline-anime. Slightly upturned at outer corners. Heavy eyeliner effect — dark fur naturally creates a winged-liner look.
eyes.glowColor: Hot pink, intensifies during special moves, leaves brief afterimage trails during shadow dash

accessories: Thin spiked choker with a single dangling razor blade charm
Fishnet pattern shaved into the fur on both forearms
Tally marks — small notches carved into the choker's leather, 12 visible
Small nose piercing — silver stud on the left nostril
visualDesign.tail: Long, whip-thin, prehensile-looking. Tip fades to deep indigo. Moves in sharp, deliberate arcs — never lazy swaying.
visualDesign.expression: Half-lidded, unimpressed. Slight smirk. One fang barely visible.

light.name: Flicker Jab
light.animation: Lightning-fast straight claw thrust. Arm fully extends with claws spread. Motion blur / afterimage on the paw. Almost too fast to see.

heavy.name: Crescent Fang
heavy.animation: Spinning heel kick (back paw). Body rotates 270 degrees, tail whips around as a secondary visual. Leaves a pink arc trail.

special.name: Phantom Rush
special.animation: Body dissolves into a streak of hot pink and black. Phases through opponent, reappears behind them. Slash marks appear on opponent with 2-frame delay (freeze-frame hit). Afterimages trail behind in decreasing opacity.
special.visualEffect: Pink-black streak with afterimages. Hit produces an X-shaped slash mark that lingers for 15 frames before fading.

animationNotes.idle: Weight shifts between feet like a boxer. Arms held loose at sides, claws slightly extended. Tail sways in figure-eight pattern. Head tilts slightly — studying the opponent.
animationNotes.walk: Prowling gait, almost a runway strut. Hips sway, feet cross over slightly. Silent and deliberate.
animationNotes.jump: Aerial flip — tucks, rotates, extends into a diving position. Tail spirals behind.
animationNotes.crouch: One knee down, other foot planted. One paw on the ground for balance, other arm back — sprinter's start position.
animationNotes.hitstun: Barely flinches. More annoyed than hurt. Recovers with a hair-flip motion (ear flick).
animationNotes.ko: Falls backward in slow-mo style. Lands on back, one arm draped across face dramatically.

stageEntrance: Materializes from shadow, eyes glow first. Flicks the razor charm on the choker with one claw.
winPose: Turns her back to the opponent, looks over shoulder with one glowing eye. Adds a tally to the choker.
